testCases.description: Use a dedicated reviewer account with access to MCP Demo Account (organization 7620). List available organizations and select that organization before organization-scoped queries. Fixtures must remain available. Compare carrier delays with pagination. Revalidate reviewer access and fixtures on the submitted production draft before submission. Inspect actual tool calls and arguments. Execute named methods through invoke_method_read with method and params. Use describe_methods for a named method when its input schema is unclear. Method names are not separate tool calls. These cases have not been run against the production invoke endpoint.
testCases.userPrompt: Which carriers had the most delayed deliveries to Germany in July 2026?
testCases.expectedOutput: Use list_shipments_filters, get_shipment_filter_values and list_shipments through invoke_method_read. Use DELIVERED_DATE with July 1–31 2026 UTC, destination Germany and parcel.on_time_status_carrier=no, matching the live schema. Rank delayed deliveries by carrier from returned data. Follow pagination or disclose partial coverage. Never equate a page size with the total or repeat historic fixture counts.
